ownershipFindings.detachableMagazine: Capacity, starting magazines, supply refill, and maximum spares are direct WeaponMagazineComponentData fields.
ownershipFindings.defaultCustomization: When slot 5 selects a nonzero option ID, the effective tuple belongs to the customization-owned magazine preset; the base WeaponMagazine tuple is not effective.
ownershipFindings.roundsFeed: Feed capacities, spare rounds, supply refill, and starting rounds are direct WeaponRoundsComponentData fields and retain rounds semantics.
ownershipFindings.ammoBoxRefill: Ammo-box refill is derived from the direct supply refill; no independent scalar survived correlation.
ownershipFindings.alternateOptions: The catalog proves option IDs, names, and AddPaths, but the captured graph does not prove per-weapon allowed-option ownership or a unique writable override record.
